replacement.name: The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai
replacement.tagline: 1903 sea-facing heritage palace at the Gateway of India — Palace wing for heritage, Tower wing for value, Sea Lounge for the afternoon-tea ritual that is the closest thing Mumbai has to a civic institution.

replacement.name: Trident Nariman Point
replacement.tagline: Oberoi-sister tower at Nariman Point — same Arabian Sea views and Marine Drive walkout at roughly 40% the Oberoi rate. India Jones and Frangipani anchor the dining; the pool runs longer than the parent's.

replacement.name: The Oberoi Mumbai
replacement.tagline: Nariman Point tower with the full Queen's Necklace sweep — calmer than the Taj's Gateway bustle, the Oberoi signature personal service, Ziya's one Michelin star on the lobby level. The South Mumbai sea-view luxury default.

replacement.name: Four Seasons Hotel Mumbai
replacement.tagline: 33-floor glass tower in Worli — Aer rooftop bar on level 34 holds the most-photographed Mumbai skyline view. Central to BKC and Lower Parel for travellers whose Mumbai is more fashion week than Gateway tourism.
replacement.address: 1/136 Dr E Moses Road, Worli, Mumbai 400018, Maharashtra
